C0948.title: Cross-border gambling ring with 3 billion yuan turnover busted in Wushen Banner, 17 arrested
C0948.summary: In 2022, Wushen Banner Public Security Bureau cracked the major cross-border online gambling case known as the 4.07 case, arresting 17 people and tracing fund flows of 3 billion yuan. Police said the case was investigated across Yunnan, Guangdong, Guangxi, and other provinces and cities, and was the 2022 case cracked by Wushen Banner police with the largest number of people involved and the highest fund flow. The related cross-border gambling group used mobile apps to recruit gamblers online and livestreaming platforms for cross-border gambling.
